new_findings.evidence: The code makes bytes that are no frame a protocol fault only when their first four bytes read as a length above HELLO_CAP (TooLarge, host.rs:653-655: the host comment at :648-649 says exactly that, 'their first four read as a huge length') or when a length-bounded payload arrives and fails to decode (:669).
